verdict.rationale: Docs describe a live_view_url/live preview that lets a human take control mid-run for cases like CAPTCHAs or 2FA, and events can be polled to monitor a run, which supports live-watch-and-intervene workflows. However, this is scoped to specific triggers (CAPTCHA/2FA) rather than a general 'agent gets stuck, operator takes over anytime' workflow, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence confirming smooth mid-run handoff in practice. missing for 10: general-purpose stuck-detection/handoff beyond CAPTCHA/2FA scenarios, independent hands-on confirmation of live takeover working reliably, clear UI/replay-debugging tooling details.
